evidence.locator: Results RAB3A variants in ataxia families

causal_confidence.statement: Recurrent Arg83Trp in nine unrelated ataxia families; purified protein GAP-stimulated hydrolysis impaired, equivalent fly variant fails Rab3-null synaptic rescue, and tagged HEK293T interaction assays lose Rabphilin and several partners. These support a disease association/partial loss of function, not individual clinical proof.
limitations: No functional patient cells or patient-specific rescue; fly NMJ surrogate rather than cerebellar motor endpoint.
Overexpression without a fly NMJ phenotype does not exclude every dominant-negative mechanism.
GTPase/fly assays normal for other ataxia allele Ile27Thr; assay effect cannot be generalized to every RAB3A allele.
100KGP association was previously published; F10 originally categorized cerebellar hypoplasia then clinically reassigned, not an independent newly recruited replication.
Tagging and limited negative controls may affect interactome; raw proteomics workbook unreviewed.
